integrity: The proof is self-contained and exact; it uses no numerical experiment or finite enumeration. The focal source date and primary MSC were checked from arXiv:2610.02862v1. Same-model review was completed; no independent audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the real positive unit sphere of \(C^1([0,1])\) with the \(p=1\) endpoint norm. It classifies the kernel of pairwise positive-sum data and its fibers, not all quotient-kernel automorphisms or all surjective norm-additive maps. Full text of arXiv:2606.30952 could not be extracted after public-access attempts, so no whole-document noncoverage claim is made for that comparator.
title: Exact positive-sum quotient at the endpoint
